name: Scarlet Triad Thug AP OLD

items.name: Flail
items.description: This weapon consists of a wooden handle attached to a spiked ball or cylinder by a chain, rope, or strap of leather.

items.name: Javelin
items.description: This thin spear is well balanced for throwing but is not designed for melee use.

items.name: Chain Mail
items.description: A suit of chain mail consists of several pieces of armor composed of small metal rings linked together in a protective mesh. It typically includes a chain shirt, leggings, a pair of arms, and a coif, collectively protecting most of the body.

items.name: Manacles (Average) (Marked with the Symbol of the Scarlet Triad)
items.description: You can manacle someone who is willing or otherwise at your mercy as an exploration activity taking 10-30 seconds depending on the creature's size and how many manacles you apply. A two-legged creature with its legs bound takes a –15-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds, and a two-handed creature with its wrists bound has to succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5] any time it uses a manipulate action or else that action fails. This DC may be higher depending on how tightly the manacles constrain the hands. A creature bound to a stationary object is immobilized. For creatures with more or fewer limbs, the GM determines what effect manacles have, if any. Freeing a creature from average manacles requires four successful @Check[thievery|dc:27|traits:action:pick-a-lock] checks.

savenote: +2 circumstance to all saves vs. shove, trip, or being knocked prone

defensiveAbilities.name: +2 Circumstance to All Saves vs. Shove, Trip, or Being Knocked Prone
Bully's Push
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within the thug's reach misses the thug with a melee Strike.

Effect The thug attempts to Shove the triggering creature at a -2 penalty. If the thug rolls a critical failure, it gets a failure instead.

defensiveAbilities.name: Rock Dwarf
defensiveAbilities.description: When forced to move 10 feet or more, the thug is moved only half the distance.

offensiveAbilities.name: Efficient Capture
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The thug has manacles in hand and is next to a creature.

Effect The thug attempts to bind the creature's wrists or ankles with the manacles. The thug must succeed at an attack roll with a +18 modifier against the target's AC.

offensiveAbilities.name: Pack Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: The thug deals an extra 1d8 damage to any creature that's within reach of at least two of the thug's allies.
